environment.machine: Apple M1 Pro, macOS, Chrome (ANGLE Metal)
environment.window: 1512x862 logical px at 2x device pixel ratio (3024x1724 px)
environment.scene: 400 random procedural sprites, one atlas, seeded
environment.method: FrameTiming over 4 s per preset after a 1.5 s warm-up; average and p95 of totalSpan, ms
environment.notes: Chrome ran this window at about 30 Hz, so frame time is reported, not fps. Two runs on a quiet machine; runs while the machine was busy (load average 17+) were discarded as noise.

after_pixel_cap.label: snapshot capped to 1.6 MP (the new default)

snapshot_cost.note: frame ms above the no-effect baseline (3.0 ms) against snapshot megapixels
